source: The Guardian live second round results
notes: Count under way; no winner called. Extension (G1, NSC Total): Zanin extended voting to 19h BRT nationwide, but clarified it applied only to machines not yet closed at 17h; TSE resumed totalling after 19h. Lula's coalition asked over public-transport failures in 9 states (SP, AL, PE, RR, PI, PB, PA, PR, RJ) plus 3 Bahia cities; Flávio's campaign also asked for 2 more hours in rain-hit towns in MG and RS. TRE-SC said it got no notice and closed at 17h. Bolsonaro allies called it an intervention that 'only helps whoever is losing' (Guardian).
